subject: english
chapter_title: How I Taught My Grandmother to Read

concepts.title: Summary of the Story
concepts.definition: Sudha Murty recalls how her sixty-two-year-old grandmother, an avid fan of the novel Kashi Yatre by Triveni, felt helpless when the author could not read it herself; she set a deadline, learned to read from her young granddaughter, and rewarded her teacher by touching her feet.
concepts.key_idea: A determined student at sixty-two proves that learning has no age limit.
concepts.textbook_ref: iebe101.txt story sections (grandmother, Kashi Yatre, the lessons)
question_patterns: summarise the story in your own words
why did the grandmother want to learn to read
what role did the novel Kashi Yatre play in the story
how did the narrator become her grandmother's teacher
why did the grandmother touch her granddaughter's feet
what was the deadline the grandmother set for herself

solution_steps.explain: The grandmother loved the serialized novel but could not read it.
She worked hard with her granddaughter as teacher and met her deadline.
Touching the feet showed her respect for her teacher and learning.

concepts.title: Character Sketch of the Grandmother
concepts.definition: The grandmother is determined, disciplined and humble: she admits her lack, studies with the seriousness of a student, and keeps her promise of independence - deciding she will never again depend on others for reading.
concepts.key_idea: Determination plus humility: the grandmother turns weakness into achievement.
concepts.textbook_ref: iebe101.txt passages showing the grandmother's determination
question_patterns: draw a character sketch of the grandmother
what qualities of the grandmother impress you most - give reasons
how did the grandmother show she was a sincere student
why did the grandmother cry in the story
what does the story reveal about the grandmother's respect for education
compare the grandmother's student-life with a school student's

solution_steps.explain: Determination, humility, gratitude and discipline head the list.
Her exam preparation, tears and foot-touching prove each quality.
She embodies the learner's spirit at any age.

concepts.title: Theme - Age Is No Bar for Learning
concepts.definition: The story's message is that there is no age for learning: literacy empowers independence and dignity, and a sincere will can overcome years, weak eyesight or social expectations.
concepts.key_idea: Willingness to learn matters more than age or circumstance.
concepts.textbook_ref: iebe101.txt concluding reflections of the story
question_patterns: what is the theme of the story - explain

solution_steps.explain: Learning is possible at any age with will and effort.
The grandmother's achievement is the proof.
Apply the message to learners around you.
